hints.content:
There are two ways of thinking about the fastest average speed:

- Going farther in the same amount of time
- Taking less time to go the same distance

###Going farther in the same amount of time

To compare the distance the flights go for the same amount of time, Lebron can find the number of kilometers per hour.

Lebron wants to go farther, so he would want the *greatest* number of kilometers per hour.

###Taking less time to go the same distance

To compare the amount time it takes to travel the same distance, Lebron can find the minutes per kilometer.

Lebron wants to take less time, so he would want the *least* minutes per kilometer.

###Summary

To find the fastest average speed, Lebron could do either of the following:

- Find the greatest kilometers per hour.
- Find the least minutes per kilometer.

question.content:
Lebron is comparing flights departing from Minneapolis.

**Which $2$ ways could Lebron find the flight with the fastest average speed?**

[[☃ radio 1]]

choices.content: Find the least kilometers per hour.
Find the greatest kilometers per hour.
Find the least minutes per kilometer.
Find the greatest minutes per kilometer.
